section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2), a 10-item instrument used to measure positive body image on a 5-point scale. The section reports the instrument's psychometric properties including good internal reliability (Cronbach's α = .91–.94) and 3-week test-retest stability (r = .90) from validation studies in college and community samples, as well as validation in adolescent girls (ages 14-15). No specific study sample characteristics, country, or correlation data are provided in this section.
